card.name: Spots where a Pro- or Pre- word starts
card.fires_on: Responds to a word or part of a word where the next piece is likely to begin with "Pro" or "pro" (prognosis, prolonging, protective). It also fires on a few other word starts that are being spelled out, such as "Event" in a trial name or an initial "N" before a longer word.

modes.label: Before Pro- words
modes.description: The marked piece sits just before a word that continues as prognosis, prolonging or protective.
modes.example: ANT USE OF QTc INTERVAL<< PRO>>LONGING DRUGS See full prescribing

modes.label: Trial or drug name starts
modes.description: The marked piece is the start of a name or acronym in a trial title or drug name, such as Event, N, or ov.
modes.example: capsules and treat patients appropriately if SCAR is suspected. 5.10 Venothromboembolic Disease In the Fenofibrate Intervention and<< Event>> Lowering in Diabetes (FIELD) trial

card.writes: It pushes the output toward "Pro" word starts and away from "pre" and "predict" forms.
card.plain: It fires where a word is about to continue as something like "prognosis" or "prolonging", and it also fires at the starts of some trial and drug names.
